caption: Two adults stand in profile facing each other before a black curtain: a smiling blonde woman in a red turtleneck on the left, and a bald, white-bearded man in a green-and-white plaid shirt on the right. Iridescent soap bubbles hang and drift in the open space between them, their relative positions shifting gradually from frame to frame. The man's head, level at the start as he gazes toward the woman, progressively tilts upward until he looks up at the floating bubbles with his mouth open. The woman stays essentially stationary in her smiling pose, with only minor body shifts. Near the top of the frame one bubble changes shape. It stretches from a round form into an irregular, elongated blob before rounding back while remaining a single object. The black-curtain background and the framing of the two people do not change, indicating no camera movement.
relations: Man's initial level gaze shifts as his head tilts upward toward the floating bubbles, opening his mouth.
Iridescent bubbles drift in the space between the adults, their relative positions shifting gradually over time.
The highest bubble stretches from a round shape into an irregular, elongated blob before rounding back.
The woman in red remains essentially stationary in her smiling profile while the man and bubbles move.
